erin.design: Quick question — in the new environment create flow: do we keep inline field errors (live) or only show a top summary after submit? Also debating required field signals (asterisk vs visible 'Required' label) and destructive delete UX (typed confirm vs modal with warning). sam.pm: Vote: inline for single-field/live feedback, top summary when multiple fields fail after submit. For required fields: asterisk + accessible text for SRs. Delete: typed confirm for infra resources, yes. vik.engineer: +1 to both. Live inline is nice but we should debounce validation. For summary mode we should link each message to the field (anchor/focus). Typed confirm is safer but note the extra engineering/ops friction. leo.a11y: Accessibility nits: don't rely on color alone. Use role="alert" for live error announcements, add aria-invalid on inputs, and set focus to the first invalid field after submit. For required fields, include an accessible hint (not just visual asterisk). For typed confirms, make the expected string explicit to assist AT. erin.design: Copy sketch for delete modal: "Type the environment name to confirm deletion. This cannot be undone." Primary CTA = "Delete environment" (red). Default focus on "Cancel". Thoughts? sam.pm: :thumbsup: I like explicit copy. Also propose an optional 30s soft-undo (toast) for web to reduce friction for accidental deletes. design-bot: Prototype link: https://figma.redwood/abc123 — frames 10–12 show both inline and summary variants. Staging preview: https://staging.redwood/pr/412 vik.engineer: Dev note: implement live inline with a 500ms debounce and only validate fields that changed. For summary mode, server must return error keys we can anchor to inputs. Example ARIA snippet: ```html
Please fix the highlighted fields
Email is required ``` leo.a11y: Also for required marker use this pattern: `*required` so screen readers get the context. And ensure contrast on error badges >= 4.5:1. erin.design: Great feedback — I will update the comps with the inline + summary behaviour, add SR text for required, and wire the delete modal copy + typed-confirm variant. Will post updated frames. Thanks all :raised_hands:
